text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Бива Хаяхидэ in the
library,
looking perplexed about
something. I stroll over
to say hello and
ask what's wrong.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been reading picture books
to
children as an extracurricular activity,
but... it's
just not clicking with me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well... You know how fairy tales and
legends
aren't exactly true to life?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I read such stories, I can't
help but get
distracted by all the errors
in logic and
inconsistencies in them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I think I can see where she's coming
from, but I
don't fully understand what
she means.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Can you read one of those stories to me and
point out what you mean?

text_block_list.text: Sure, that seems like the best approach. Allow me to read Momotaro for you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: "Once upon a time, in a land far away..."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"An old woman found a giant peach and
took it
home."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"She and her husband go to cut the
peach, when
suddenly..."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
See, here's the part where my suspension
of
disbelief starts to break down.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I already had trouble swallowing the fact
that a
giant peach was floating down the
river out of
nowhere...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But then we discover that Momotaro was
inside of
the peach the whole time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Based on the information available, we
have to
assume that he must have been
inside it for
anywhere between a few
minutes to an hour.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, how did he not die of

asphyxiation?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Then there's the part where the old man
and
woman cut the peach in half.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
How did they avoid cutting Momotaro in
half
too? Did they take care to cut
around him or
something?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But that wouldn't make any sense since
they
didn't even know he was in there.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Even if I am, what benefit is there to
learn about
things that are logically
impossible?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'd rather not take part in teaching
falsities to
children.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
From the look on her face, I can tell
she's truly
dedicated to this. If she's
going to take things this
seriously,
then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you make it a study group activity?

text_block_list.text:
From the look on her face, I can tell
she's truly
dedicated to this. If she's
going to take things this
seriously,
then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you make it a study group activity?

text_block_list.text: My own twist?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Yeah. Try inserting some logic in the stories.

text_block_list.text:
You mean reconstruct them in a way that
makes
sense? That does sound
intriguing...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When it's time for Бива Хаяхидэ to read
to the
children again, she put her new
tactic to work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"An old woman found a giant peach and
took it
home."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"The old man and woman were puzzled
by the
strange hole in the peach and
realized it must've
been a breathing
hole."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"Together, the two of them cut into the
peach
very, very carefully."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The peach had a breathing hole in it? I
don't
remember that part...
text_block_list.name: Energetic Child

text_block_list.text:
But if there wasn't one, Momotaro
wouldn't be
able to breathe inside the
peach.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It would be very sad if that were the
case, don't
you think?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah! It would be super, duper sad!
text_block_list.name: Precocious Child

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A kind stranger must have
thought the
same and made that hole for
him.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Now, back to the story...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"Momotaro emerged from the peach
hale and
whole thanks to the breathing
hole."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
"And because the old man and woman
had cut
into the peach so carefully, he
didn't have a
single scratch on him."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yay! He was okay!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Child

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Good for Momotaro!
text_block_list.name: Precocious Child

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's logically rewritten
children's
stories initially cause some
confusion...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A study group, you say?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The children might find such a thing
dull, but
holding a group discussion
might be a good way
to discuss the flaws
in such stories.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I like that idea! I'll start preparing
for our
discussion right away!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When it's time for Бива Хаяхидэ to read
to the
children again, she carefully
presents her ideas to
her audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The glass slippers Cinderella wore may
look
beautiful, but they're actually
incredibly
dangerous.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Because glass is hard, the likelihood of
injuring
your feet while wearing them is
high.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And if they were to break, they would
leave glass
shards everywhere.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wow! That would be really bad!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Child

text_block_list.text:
Exactly. That's why you should wear
shoes made
from safe materials and not
glass slippers, even if
they're from a fairy
godmother.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When the Big Bad Wolf asked Little Red
Riding
Hood where she was going, she
told him, thus
revealing the location of
her grandmother's
house.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
However, if she had kept her guard up
and
refused to answer, her grandmother
would've
escaped the tragic fate of
being eaten.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The moral of the story is that you should
run away
from a stranger if they try to
talk to you.
Understood?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Precocious Child

text_block_list.text:
Although picture books can be quite
charming,
they occasionally contain
problematic elements.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You have to learn how to identify these
problems
and avoid them in order to live
a good life.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Now, were you all able to learn
something new
from today's story time?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah! We did!
text_block_list.name: Children

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's educational story time
ends up
being a big hit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But in the end, it was a highly
educational
experience for the children.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not only did the children love her, but
she seems
to have greatly enjoyed
herself too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
